title: bug: an expected owner-guard refusal pages #governors and overwrites lastCommitOutcome
description: After task-6aa460bb33184e1b84fc9c9e5c0a4560, a non-assignee wrapper exit (typically an architect whose planned task a worker claimed) records record_commit {outcome: refused, code: MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_ACTIVE_ASSIGNEE | MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_OWNER_UNKNOWN}. recordCommit.ts alerts #governors on every non-committed/nothing outcome and stamps task.lastCommitOutcome, so an expected, nothing-lost refusal pages governors (once per task per window) and can overwrite the owner's committed outcome shown by get_context. Decide: skip the #governors alert for these two codes, and/or do not let a non-assignee refusal replace a committed lastCommitOutcome.
definitionOfDone: record_commit does not page #governors for MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_ACTIVE_ASSIGNEE / MOE_COMMIT_REFUSED_OWNER_UNKNOWN (task channel line kept)
A later owner-guard refusal does not hide an earlier committed outcome from get_context (decided and tested)
